claim: config field show_conversation_footer bool default True loads from TOML and SQLLENS_AGENT__SHOW_CONVERSATION_FOOTER with env winning

evidence: config.py:458-466 declares show_conversation_footer: bool = Field(default=True) on AgentRuntimeConfig, which is Config.agent (line 667). Config.model_config (651-655) sets env_prefix SQLLENS_ and env_nested_delimiter '__', so SQLLENS_AGENT__SHOW_CONVERSATION_FOOTER maps to agent.show_conversation_footer. settings_customise_sources (674-700) returns init, env, TomlConfigSettingsSource, file_secret in that order, so env outranks TOML. claim: _failing_real_agent makes the real vendored Agent hit its catch-all handler by replacing tool_registry.execute, and the _TOOL_PROMPT question actually triggers a tool call so execute is invoked
verify_hint: Check _agent's stub LLM emits a tool call for _TOOL_PROMPT and that Agent calls self.tool_registry.execute inside the catch-all try
evidence: tests/unit/test_conversation_footer_setting.py:60-69 builds the real Agent via _agent(_GatedRunSql()) and sets agent.tool_registry.execute to a function that raises RuntimeError. agent.py:863 calls `await self.tool_registry.execute(tool_call, context)` as an instance attribute lookup, so the replacement is used. No try/except encloses line 863 in the tool loop: the only try/except/finally lines are 174, 190, 296, 355, 462, 513 and 520, all outside that span. The exception therefore reaches the send_message catch-all (agent.py:180-227), which appends '\n\nConversation ID: <id>' at line 215. In test_query_database_tool_history.py the _Messages stub (lines 75-101) returns a run_sql tool_use with stop_reason tool_use when the last user message contains _TOOL_PROMPT ('use the tool'). _call defaults to question f'q, {_TOOL_PROMPT}' (test_conversation_footer_setting.py:90), so the tool call is emitted and execute is invoked. I did not run the tests.
